[Data Science]{.blue} ::: {.my-grey} [{{< meta semester >}} | {{< meta course >}}]{}
[Jeffrey M. Girard | Lecture {{< meta lecture >}}]{} ::: ![](../../img/proud_coder_357EDD.svg){.absolute bottom=30 right=0 width="400"} ::: ## Roadmap ::: {.columns .pv4} ::: {.column width="60%"} - Transform data by row using `arrange()`, `filter()`, and `distinct()` - Transform data by column using `mutate()`, `select()`, `rename()`, and `relocate()` ::: ::: {.column .tc .pv4 width="40%"} {{< lif "../../icons/map.json" trigger=hover colors=secondary:#2a76dd class=rc >}} ::: ::: ## Basic wrangling verbs {.smaller} ::: {.columns .pv4} ::: {.column width="60%"} - [tidyverse]{.b .blue} provides tools for wrangling tibbles - These functions are named after *verbs* - So if you name your objects after *nouns*... - ...your code becomes easier to read ::: {.fragment .mt1} | Noun(noun) ❌ | Verb(noun) ✔️ | |:----------------------|:----------------| | `blender(fruit)` | `blend(fruit)` | | `screwdriver(screw)` | `drive(screw)` | | `boxcutter(box)` | `cut(box)` | ::: ::: ::: {.column .tc .pv5 width="40%"} {{< lif "../../icons/wrench.json" trigger=hover colors=secondary:#2a76dd class=rc >}} ::: ::: ## Important: Saving changes {.smaller} ::: {.columns .pv4} ::: {.column width="60%"} - `dplyr` functions **do not** modify the original - Running a command returns a *copy* of the result - It does not change the original object! - This is useful in *teaching* but less so in practice ::: {.fragment .mt1} - To **save** changes, you must use assignment [`<-`]{.b .blue} - Print only: `arrange(data, var)` - Save/update: `data <- arrange(data, var)` ::: ::: ::: {.column .tc .pv5 width="40%"} {{< lif "../../icons/caution.json" trigger=hover colors=secondary:#2a76dd class=rc >}} ::: ::: ## Setup ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) data("starwars", package = "dplyr") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} glimpse(starwars) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 87 Columns: 14 $ name "Luke Skywalker", "C-3PO", "R2-D2", "Darth Vader", "Leia Or… $ height 172, 167, 96, 202, 150, 178, 165, 97, 183, 182, 188, 180, 2… $ mass 77.0, 75.0, 32.0, 136.0, 49.0, 120.0, 75.0, 32.0, 84.0, 77.… $ hair_color "blond", NA, NA, "none", "brown", "brown, grey", "brown", N… $ skin_color "fair", "gold", "white, blue", "white", "light", "light", "… $ eye_color "blue", "yellow", "red", "yellow", "brown", "blue", "blue",… $ birth_year 19.0, 112.0, 33.0, 41.9, 19.0, 52.0, 47.0, NA, 24.0, 57.0, … $ sex "male", "none", "none", "male", "female", "male", "female",… $ gender "masculine", "masculine", "masculine", "masculine", "femini… $ homeworld "Tatooine", "Tatooine", "Naboo", "Tatooine", "Alderaan", "T… $ species "Human", "Droid", "Droid", "Human", "Human", "Human", "Huma… $ films <"A New Hope", "The Empire Strikes Back", "Return of the J… $ vehicles <"Snowspeeder", "Imperial Speeder Bike">, <>, <>, <>, "Imp… $ starships <"X-wing", "Imperial shuttle">, <>, <>, "TIE Advanced x1",… ``` ::: ::: # Rows ## Row-focused verbs {.smaller} ::: {.columns .pv4} ::: {.column width="60%"} - [Arrange]{.b .blue} - Reorders the rows according to the values in specified columns ::: {.fragment .mt1} - [Filter]{.b .blue} - Retains only the rows that satisfy your specified conditions ::: ::: {.fragment .mt1} - [Distinct]{.b .blue} - Removes duplicate rows to retain only unique combinations of values ::: ::: ::: {.column .tc .pv5 width="40%"} {{< lif "../../icons/rowing.json" trigger=hover colors=secondary:#2a76dd class=rc >}} ::: ::: # Arrange ## Arrange alphabetically from A to Z ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Sort the rows by the name variable (ascending) arrange(starwars, name) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Ackbar 180 83 none brown mot… orange 41 male mascu… 2 Adi Gall… 184 50 none dark blue NA fema… femin… 3 Anakin S… 188 84 blond fair blue 41.9 male mascu… 4 Arvel Cr… NA NA brown fair brown NA male mascu… 5 Ayla Sec… 178 55 none blue hazel 48 fema… femin… 6 BB8 NA NA none none black NA none mascu… 7 Bail Pre… 191 NA black tan brown 67 male mascu… 8 Barriss … 166 50 black yellow blue 40 fema… femin… # ℹ 79 more rows # ℹ 5 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: ## Arrange alphabetically from Z to A ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Sort the rows by the name variable (descending) arrange(starwars, desc(name)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Zam Wese… 168 55 blonde fair, gre… yellow NA fema… femin… 2 Yoda 66 17 white green brown 896 male mascu… 3 Yarael P… 264 NA none white yellow NA male mascu… 4 Wilhuff … 180 NA auburn, g… fair blue 64 male mascu… 5 Wicket S… 88 20 brown brown brown 8 male mascu… 6 Wedge An… 170 77 brown fair hazel 21 male mascu… 7 Watto 137 NA black blue, grey yellow NA male mascu… 8 Wat Tamb… 193 48 none green, gr… unknown NA male mascu… # ℹ 79 more rows # ℹ 5 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: ## Arrange numerically ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Sort the rows by height from shortest to tallest arrange(starwars, height) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Yoda 66 17 white green brown 896 male mascu… 2 Ratts Ty… 79 15 none grey, blue unknown NA male mascu… 3 Wicket S… 88 20 brown brown brown 8 male mascu… 4 Dud Bolt 94 45 none blue, grey yellow NA male mascu… 5 R2-D2 96 32 white, bl… red 33 none mascu… 6 R4-P17 96 NA none silver, r… red, blue NA none femin… 7 R5-D4 97 32 white, red red NA none mascu… 8 Sebulba 112 40 none grey, red orange NA male mascu… # ℹ 79 more rows # ℹ 5 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: ## Arrange by multiple variables ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Sort by multiple variables to break ties arrange(starwars, hair_color, mass) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Mon Moth… 150 NA auburn fair blue 48 fema… femin… 2 Wilhuff … 180 NA auburn, g… fair blue 64 male mascu… 3 Obi-Wan … 182 77 auburn, w… fair blue-gray 57 male mascu… 4 Barriss … 166 50 black yellow blue 40 fema… femin… 5 Luminara… 170 56.2 black yellow blue 58 fema… femin… 6 Boba Fett 183 78.2 black fair brown 31.5 male mascu… 7 Lando Ca… 177 79 black dark brown 31 male mascu… 8 Jango Fe… 183 79 black tan brown 66 male mascu… # ℹ 79 more rows # ℹ 5 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: # Filter ## Filter by exact match ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Retain only rows where the species is exactly "Droid" filter(starwars, species == "Droid") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 6 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 C-3PO 167 75 gold yellow 112 none masculi… 2 R2-D2 96 32 white, blue red 33 none masculi… 3 R5-D4 97 32 white, red red NA none masculi… 4 IG-88 200 140 none metal red 15 none masculi… 5 R4-P17 96 NA none silver, red red, blue NA none feminine 6 BB8 NA NA none none black NA none masculi… # ℹ 5 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: ## Filter by numeric condition ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Retain only characters with a body mass greater than or equal to 100 filter(starwars, mass >= 100) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 10 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Darth Va… 202 136 none white yellow 41.9 male mascu… 2 Owen Lars 178 120 brown, gr… light blue 52 male mascu… 3 Chewbacca 228 112 brown unknown blue 200 male mascu… 4 Jabba De… 175 1358 green-tan… orange 600 herm… mascu… 5 Jek Tono… 180 110 brown fair blue NA 6 IG-88 200 140 none metal red 15 none mascu… 7 Bossk 190 113 none green red 53 male mascu… 8 Dexter J… 198 102 none brown yellow NA male mascu… # ℹ 2 more rows # ℹ 5 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: ## Filter by multiple conditions (AND) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Retain "Droid" characters AND those with mass < 50 filter(starwars, species == "Droid", mass < 50) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 2 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 R2-D2 96 32 white, blue red 33 none masculine 2 R5-D4 97 32 white, red red NA none masculine # ℹ 5 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: ## Filter by multiple conditions (OR) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Retain characters that have sex equal to male OR none filter(starwars, sex == "male" | sex == "none") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 66 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Luke Sky… 172 77 blond fair blue 19 male mascu… 2 C-3PO 167 75 gold yellow 112 none mascu… 3 R2-D2 96 32 white, bl… red 33 none mascu… 4 Darth Va… 202 136 none white yellow 41.9 male mascu… 5 Owen Lars 178 120 brown, gr… light blue 52 male mascu… 6 R5-D4 97 32 white, red red NA none mascu… 7 Biggs Da… 183 84 black light brown 24 male mascu… 8 Obi-Wan … 182 77 auburn, w… fair blue-gray 57 male mascu… # ℹ 58 more rows # ℹ 5 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: # Distinct ## Find distinct values ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Find the unique homeworlds listed in the dataset distinct(starwars, homeworld) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 49 × 1 homeworld 1 Tatooine 2 Naboo 3 Alderaan 4 Stewjon 5 Eriadu 6 Kashyyyk 7 Corellia 8 Rodia # ℹ 41 more rows ``` ::: ::: ## Find distinct combinations ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Find unique combinations of species and sex distinct(starwars, species, sex) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 41 × 2 species sex 1 Human male 2 Droid none 3 Human female 4 Wookiee male 5 Rodian male 6 Hutt hermaphroditic 7 8 Yoda's species male # ℹ 33 more rows ``` ::: ::: # Columns ## Column-focused verbs {.smaller} ::: {.columns .pv4} ::: {.column width="60%"} - [Select]{.b .blue} - Retains specific columns and drops the rest ::: {.fragment .mt1} - [Mutate]{.b .blue} - Creates new columns or modifies existing ones ::: ::: {.fragment .mt1} - [Rename]{.b .blue} - Changes the names of specific columns ::: ::: {.fragment .mt1} - [Relocate]{.b .blue} - Changes the positions of specific columns ::: ::: ::: {.column .tc .pv5 width="40%"} {{< lif "../../icons/pillar.json" trigger=hover colors=secondary:#2a76dd class=rc >}} ::: ::: # Select ## Select specific columns ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Retain only the name, height, and mass columns select(starwars, name, height, mass) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 3 name height mass 1 Luke Skywalker 172 77 2 C-3PO 167 75 3 R2-D2 96 32 4 Darth Vader 202 136 5 Leia Organa 150 49 6 Owen Lars 178 120 7 Beru Whitesun Lars 165 75 8 R5-D4 97 32 # ℹ 79 more rows ``` ::: ::: ## Drop specific columns ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Retain all columns EXCEPT films, vehicles, and starships select(starwars, -films, -vehicles, -starships) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 11 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Luke Sky… 172 77 blond fair blue 19 male mascu… 2 C-3PO 167 75 gold yellow 112 none mascu… 3 R2-D2 96 32 white, bl… red 33 none mascu… 4 Darth Va… 202 136 none white yellow 41.9 male mascu… 5 Leia Org… 150 49 brown light brown 19 fema… femin… 6 Owen Lars 178 120 brown, gr… light blue 52 male mascu… 7 Beru Whi… 165 75 brown light blue 47 fema… femin… 8 R5-D4 97 32 white, red red NA none mascu… # ℹ 79 more rows # ℹ 2 more variables: homeworld , species ``` ::: ::: ## Select all between two columns ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Retain all columns between height and gender select(starwars, height:gender) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 8 height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 172 77 blond fair blue 19 male masculine 2 167 75 gold yellow 112 none masculine 3 96 32 white, blue red 33 none masculine 4 202 136 none white yellow 41.9 male masculine 5 150 49 brown light brown 19 female feminine 6 178 120 brown, grey light blue 52 male masculine 7 165 75 brown light blue 47 female feminine 8 97 32 white, red red NA none masculine # ℹ 79 more rows ``` ::: ::: ## Select using helpers ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Retain only columns that end with the phrase "color" select(starwars, ends_with("color")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 3 hair_color skin_color eye_color 1 blond fair blue 2 gold yellow 3 white, blue red 4 none white yellow 5 brown light brown 6 brown, grey light blue 7 brown light blue 8 white, red red # ℹ 79 more rows ``` ::: ::: :::{.fsmaller} See also: `starts_with()`, `contains()`, `matches()`, and `where()` ::: # Mutate ## Mutate new columns ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Create a new column and add all the way to the right mutate(starwars, height_m = height / 100) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 15 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Luke Sky… 172 77 blond fair blue 19 male mascu… 2 C-3PO 167 75 gold yellow 112 none mascu… 3 R2-D2 96 32 white, bl… red 33 none mascu… 4 Darth Va… 202 136 none white yellow 41.9 male mascu… 5 Leia Org… 150 49 brown light brown 19 fema… femin… 6 Owen Lars 178 120 brown, gr… light blue 52 male mascu… 7 Beru Whi… 165 75 brown light blue 47 fema… femin… 8 R5-D4 97 32 white, red red NA none mascu… # ℹ 79 more rows # ℹ 6 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships , height_m ``` ::: ::: ## Mutate existing columns ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Modify the height variable "in place" mutate(starwars, height = height * 10) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Luke Sky… 1720 77 blond fair blue 19 male mascu… 2 C-3PO 1670 75 gold yellow 112 none mascu… 3 R2-D2 960 32 white, bl… red 33 none mascu… 4 Darth Va… 2020 136 none white yellow 41.9 male mascu… 5 Leia Org… 1500 49 brown light brown 19 fema… femin… 6 Owen Lars 1780 120 brown, gr… light blue 52 male mascu… 7 Beru Whi… 1650 75 brown light blue 47 fema… femin… 8 R5-D4 970 32 white, red red NA none mascu… # ℹ 79 more rows # ℹ 5 more variables: homeworld , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: # Rename and Relocate ## Rename columns ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Change the name of 'homeworld' to 'planet' (new = old) rename(starwars, planet = homeworld) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 14 name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex gender 1 Luke Sky… 172 77 blond fair blue 19 male mascu… 2 C-3PO 167 75 gold yellow 112 none mascu… 3 R2-D2 96 32 white, bl… red 33 none mascu… 4 Darth Va… 202 136 none white yellow 41.9 male mascu… 5 Leia Org… 150 49 brown light brown 19 fema… femin… 6 Owen Lars 178 120 brown, gr… light blue 52 male mascu… 7 Beru Whi… 165 75 brown light blue 47 fema… femin… 8 R5-D4 97 32 white, red red NA none mascu… # ℹ 79 more rows # ℹ 5 more variables: planet , species , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: ## Relocate columns ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Move the 'species' column to the very first position relocate(starwars, species, .before = name) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 87 × 14 species name height mass hair_color skin_color eye_color birth_year sex 1 Human Luke Sk… 172 77 blond fair blue 19 male 2 Droid C-3PO 167 75 gold yellow 112 none 3 Droid R2-D2 96 32 white, bl… red 33 none 4 Human Darth V… 202 136 none white yellow 41.9 male 5 Human Leia Or… 150 49 brown light brown 19 fema… 6 Human Owen La… 178 120 brown, gr… light blue 52 male 7 Human Beru Wh… 165 75 brown light blue 47 fema… 8 Droid R5-D4 97 32 white, red red NA none # ℹ 79 more rows # ℹ 5 more variables: gender , homeworld , films , # vehicles , starships ``` ::: ::: :::{.fsmaller} Can also use `.after` and position numbers, e.g., `.after = 1` :::

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
